lines.t: Where are you?
Here it echo when I call your name.
Where are you?
My altar gathers dust instead of flame.
Where are you?
Calling Me “Lord,” with blocked ears and eyes.
You are undone. Only I can make this right.
I don't sense your calm in patient wait.
You scratch each want with itchy pride.
I don't see you let me lead.
Drew custom maps, then called it guide.
My messengers came to feed.
By tickling tongues, you starved.
If you loved My Law as joy,
Why bar its door and keep guard?
Where are you?
Hear it echo when I call your name.
Where are you?
My altar gathers dust instead of flame.
Where are you?
Calling Me “Lord,” with blocked ears and eyes.
You are undone. Only I can make this right.
Can not see of Myself in you.
Stained glass surrounds to suit your ease.
Quenched Holy fire with busied chores.
With ember cold, you learned to freeze.
You spoke great things and won applause,
then hid the Voice that calls the least.
I saw no visits when in prison.
My hunger swelled during your feast.
Where are you?
It just echos when I call your name.
Where are you?
My altar gathers dust instead of flame.
Where are you?
Calling Me “Lord,” with blocked ears and eyes.
You are undone. Only I can make this right.
The only anchor is My truth.
You drifted after teachers’ wind.
You kept My place as ornament,
what i break down you can not mend.
You made yourself both judge and church.
Watered down My Word so it never stung.
You hoarded love for self, and clan.
Then left the wound where mercy hung.
Look at yourself!
Not as imagined, but as you are.
My child, let go of childish ways;
Discipline is mercy, not the scar.
Break now! Let the plow turn deep,
Who seeks a cure except the ill?
Only ruin sown in truth will keep
It's emptiness that can be filled.
Where are you?
It just echos when I call your name.
Where are you?
My altar gathers dust instead of flame.
Where are you?
Calling Me “Lord,” with blocked ears and eyes.
When you turn, Oh, watch Me make this right.
Let it shatter
let your arrogance die.
Come empty.
Then learn to keep the line.
